_note: Player profile extras (Jack, Nov 3, 2026). Every player with an all-state or all-conference pick already gets a profile automatically; add a player here only to give their profile season stats, a bio, a height, links, or a grad-year / position fix. Match is by name (case, punctuation and Jr./II suffixes ignored) and school id. 'aka' merges other spellings into this profile. Season stat fields are all optional: gp, pts, ppg, reb, rpg, ast, apg, stl, spg, blk, bpg, fgm, fga, fg_pct, tpm (3-pointers made), ft_pct, grade, note, src. Leave out what the clipping doesn't have.
